title: How to increase the life expectancy of your pet?
description:
On average, dogs live between 10 and 12 years while cats live an average of 18 years.
But by taking care of your pets, you can help them live longer.
- Watch his weight: according to one study, a dog at the ideal weight can gain up to 34 months life expectancy.
- Give preference to industrial kibbles: which constitute a diet adapted to the animal's nutritional needs.
- Use dispensing toys, more stimulating for the animal.
- Make a regular follow-up of the health of your pet: at least one annual visit to the veterinarian and three visits per year for senior animals in order to be able to diagnose quickly diagnose possible diseases.
- Guarantee a healthy and stimulating environment for your pet: for cats, it is necessary to allow them to do their claws and to climb.
Dogs need to exercise, smell and chew.
